sections.title: The caption was not the charge.
notes: Read this carefully. The U.S. Attorney's Office for D.C. reported about 1,583 people federally charged over January 6. None was charged under 18 U.S.C. § 2383, the insurrection statute. That does not mean nothing was charged: prosecutors used other statutes, including assault, obstruction and trespass. The Ellipse speech contains both "fight like hell" and "peacefully and patriotically."

j6-1.title: Bloodbath
lines: The caption: If he loses, it will be a bloodbath. He wants another January 6.
The file: He said the word twice, at 29:45, about Chinese cars built in Mexico and a 100 percent tariff. March 16, 2024, is the only occasion located.
j6-1.label: On the record

j6-2.title: Insurrection
lines: The caption: January 6 was insurrection, charged as such.

The file: 18 U.S.C. § 2383. USAO-DC: about 1,583 people federally charged, including about 608 charged with assaulting officers; leaders of the Oath Keepers and Proud Boys were convicted of seditious conspiracy under § 2384. Zero under § 2383.
j6-2.label: On the record

j6-3.title: He never said peacefully
lines: The caption: The speech was only “fight like hell.”
The file: C-SPAN has the Ellipse. “Peacefully and patriotically” is on the same tape. The BBC splice put two lines fifty-four minutes apart into one thought.
j6-3.label: On the record

j6-4.title: Stand by
lines: The caption: He deployed the Proud Boys to January 6.

The file: “Stand back and stand by” is on the September 29, 2020, debate transcript. That is months before January 6. The words are his. No charging document shows a chain of command from that sentence to the Capitol.
j6-4.label: On the record

j6-5.title: The Senate convicted
lines: The caption: The Senate convicted him of insurrection.
The file: The second trial ended 57–43. Conviction required two-thirds. He was acquitted.
j6-5.label: On the record

j6-6.title: Bloodbath
lines: The caption: If he loses it will be a bloodbath. He wants another January 6.
The file: Chinese car plants in Mexico. A 100 percent tariff. “They’re not going to sell those cars.”
j6-6.label: On the record

j6-7.title: January 6 speech
lines: The caption: Walk to the Capitol and fight like hell, as one order.
The file: “Peacefully and patriotically.” The BBC splice stuck two lines fifty-four minutes apart.
j6-7.label: On the record

j6-8.title: Insurrection

The file: 18 U.S.C. § 2383. About 1,583 federally charged, including about 608 charged with assaulting officers; leaders of the Oath Keepers and Proud Boys were convicted of seditious conspiracy under § 2384. Zero under the insurrection statute.
j6-8.label: On the record
